name: Aedas Homes, S.A.
summary: Aedas Homes, S.A. engages in the development of residential properties in Spain. The company focuses on single-family homes; provides real estate services; and decoration and interior design services, as well as develop turnkey build-to-rent properties. It serves individuals and institutional investors. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain. Aedas Homes, S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Neinor Homes, S.A.
